notes: Car E — the desktop client: an Electron shell (free tooling, dev dependencies only) that puts the local console behind a transparent always-on-top HUD window. (1) Shell: a frameless transparent overlay window carrying web/static/hud.html — an opacity slider (0.2-1.0 window alpha), an always-on-top toggle and a click-through toggle (setIgnoreMouseEvents with pointer forwarding) — plus the standard console window (closing it minimizes to tray), a system tray with open/HUD/quit entries, and honest per-platform transparency notes (vibrancy is set on macOS only; Linux and Windows fall back to plain alpha transparency, verified working under WSLg). The HUD page is served from the console origin so it shares same-origin i18n; it degrades to a localized notice when opened outside the shell and never invents bridge APIs (Quit lives in the tray menu). Eight new hud.* locale keys take both packs to 285/285. (2) Console supervisor: repo resolution (AIDOG_REPO env > dev-relative > cwd/parent > userData cache), probe-then-attach when a console already listens on 8790, otherwise spawn python3 server.py under {repo}/web with health polling, and on exit kill only what it spawned. All three legs were exercised: attach against the running production console, spawn on port 18790 with post-exit port cleanup, and an honest no-repo failure (SELFTEST ok:false stage:repo rc=1 plus an error page that says how to fix it). (3) Packaging: electron-builder dir + tar.gz targets (about 114 MB); both the unpacked binary and the tar-extracted binary ran the selftest green on this machine (console load, preload bridge on the console origin, setOpacity/getOpacity IPC roundtrip). Windows and macOS targets were not built or verified in this environment and are documented as such; the package is a shell that needs a local install (no bundled python/web), uses the default application icon, and ships no signing, auto-update, or telemetry. Verified: desktop node --test 15/15, dev/packaged/tar selftests, a 12-check E2E script run to completion, offline suites held at core 959/959, smoke 142/142, setup 99/99, router 30/30, memory 58/58, doctor 0F/0W, publish READY, locale packs 285/285.
